summary: Frontend-only testing (375x667 Expo web) of CPD Resources sections, My CPD attach+share flow, Certificate upload with CPD hours, Integrations two Drive spaces, Company Drive space switcher + pins. ALL requested flows PASS. Home social-highlight regression SKIPPED (dashboard has no latest_social). No deprecated Expo packages / red screens / page errors found. Only minor/design issues below.

minor.issue: Soft-deletes the certificate but leaves the CPD log created from it (cpd_logs.cert_id) in My CPD and still counted in year hours; also the Google Drive copy (StaffHub Certificates folder) is not removed. Decide intended behaviour (at least prompt or cascade).
Pinned items return size=None, modified='' so pinned row meta just shows 'File' instead of size/updated (server.py ~1039).

When admin changes a space's folder, old pins (root_id of previous folder) are left orphaned in drive_pins; pins also upsert by file_id only, so a file reachable from both spaces can only be pinned in one.

ui_bugs.issue: router.back() is called unconditionally; when the screen is opened directly/refreshed (no history) a red toast "The action 'GO_BACK' was not handled" appears after the success toast. Use router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/(tabs)/certificates'). Normal flow from Certificates FAB works fine. Reference: /app/frontend/app/upload-certificate.tsx:128

issues: Space buttons are truncated at 375px width: 'Therapist Resou…' / 'Participants Res…'. Use shorter labels (e.g. 'Therapists' / 'Participants'), allow 2 lines, or smaller font. Reference: /app/frontend/app/drive.tsx:77
Upload FAB overlaps the delete icon of the last visible certificate card at 375x667 (check list paddingBottom accounts for FAB height).
Chip component exposes no accessibilityState selected (aria-selected/checked null) — selected state not announced by screen readers (minor a11y).

action_items: LOW: upload-certificate.tsx:128 guard router.back() with router.canGoBack() fallback to replace('/(tabs)/certificates').
LOW: Shorten/wrap Company Drive space button labels so they are not truncated on 375px phones.
LOW: Decide cascade behaviour when a certificate with a linked CPD log is deleted (log currently remains + counted).
LOW: Return size/modified for pinned drive items or hide meta; clean orphaned pins when a space folder is changed/cleared.

INFO: 3 TEST certificate copies (TEST cert, TEST UI Cert CPD, TEST UI Cert NoCPD) were mirrored to the real Google Drive 'StaffHub Certificates' folder by the upload flow; DB records are soft-deleted but Drive files remain — remove them manually in Drive if desired.
